items.title: Beijing Sinotau International Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. (09941)
items.en_title: Beijing Sinotau International Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. (09941)
items.en_oneliner: Biotech firm Sinotau closed subscriptions at noon on 19 November, priced at HK$52.00 (the bottom of its range), listing 24 November; it focuses on radiopharmaceutical diagnostics and therapies. It closed the grey market down 1.25% at HK$51.35, after opening at HK$76.00. It closed its first day down 23.08%.
